label: Portable relational map
text: A changing state can leave behind a relation-set that remains useful for orientation without reproducing the originating experience.
rivals_or_limits: ordinary memory consolidation
the retained map may be selective or distorted
phenomenological certainty is not external verification

label: Failure-fragment recomposition
text: Fragments treated as failures or dead ends can become inputs to a new composite rather than being erased.
rivals_or_limits: metaphorical reframing
caption is partial
no cognitive or technical mechanism is established

label: Constraint-topology bypass
text: An intractable problem can become tractable when a nonessential represented constraint is removed or the intervention frame changes.
rivals_or_limits: cutting may destroy an essential invariant
the source uses analogy rather than a universal method

label: Functional inversion
text: Under a changed configuration, the same structural element can change from preventing an outcome to enabling it.
rivals_or_limits: fictional-reference influence
ordinary contextual memory cueing
role change is not obstacle removal

label: Selective value extraction under impurity
text: A discriminating system may receive a usable fraction from a mixed field before the unusable fraction is cleared.
rivals_or_limits: not every adverse field contains value
debris is not thereby beneficial
danger need not be endured

label: Archive-to-working-set projection
text: A portable public instrument can preserve selected relations, boundaries, and evidence routes without reproducing the full private archive.
rivals_or_limits: selection can omit a consequential contradiction
limited-access sources reduce independent verifiability

label: Local direction differs from route progress
text: On a known constrained route, immediate movement away from a target can coexist with progress along the route; without route evidence, a setback is not thereby progress.
rivals_or_limits: route may be unknown in real situations
ordinary navigational explanation is sufficient for the labyrinth example
does not establish a metaphysical causal mechanism

label: Availability can precede recognition
text: A functionally sufficient resource can be present before an observer recognizes it as satisfying the target, especially when recognition is overfit to an expected route or form.
rivals_or_limits: Dana’s stronger causal account of the bucket’s appearance is separate
not every substitute satisfies the target
functional criteria remain necessary

label: Orientation and evaluation have distinct jobs
text: Felt salience can be treated as orientation information while reasoning evaluates assumptions, constraints, and action; neither role by itself establishes factual truth or chosen value.
rivals_or_limits: source makes stronger metaphysical frequency claims not adopted here
emotion can mislead
logic can optimize an unwanted objective

label: Practice serves capacity rather than rigidity
text: A routine is useful insofar as it develops the capacity it was built for; context-sensitive deviation can preserve that purpose when strict adherence would defeat it.
rivals_or_limits: not every distraction is a meaningful exception
routine can still be necessary for skill development
purpose must be specified
